_README: Machine-readable contract between qdistro (producer) and qdshell (consumer).
This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the small set of identifiers that
qdshell hand-mirrors in QML/JS and that qdistro produces in Python/C. It exists
to make cross-repo drift FAIL A TEST instead of silently misrendering.
- qdistro/tests/unit/test_shell_contract.py  asserts these values match the
literals in Services/Qdistro/*.{qml,js} and Modules/Bar/Widgets/*.js match.
Scope is deliberately narrow: only the contract surface qdshell intentionally
consumes. Do NOT grow this into a full schema/codegen — see doc/ and the codex
review that gated this. tier3/tier5 prefixes have no Python runtime constant
today (qdwin produces those secctx app_ids in C); this fixture is their anchor.

broker_reply_fields._doc: Fields qdshell PARSES from each broker reply. The guard asserts qdshell still references each name (silent drop of a depended-on field is the failure mode). A UI may legitimately ignore additional producer fields.

ListReceivers._doc: D-Bus signature a(iss): array of (uid, service, friendly_name) tuples; positional, order matters.

ListSilos._doc: Returns a single JSON string; qdshell reads only uid+name per silo object.
